notes.title: Cleaners!
notes.notes:
[p]The new update introduces a new type of [b]Employee[/b], along with some changes:

[b]Cleaners[/b]
New employees have arrived at your Arcade: the Cleaners! They are responsible for keeping the environment clean, patrolling the place and collecting any trash left by customers. 

Trash now appears dynamically based on the number of customers in the Arcade. The more crowded it is, the higher the chance someone will litter! To reduce this chance, place trash cans strategically around the map.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274692/82ef043a601910f1017f9e5afb8954476d630fd6.png"][/img]

[b]Cleanliness Bonus[/b]
A new modifier has been added to the popularity panel: the Cleanliness Bonus. Keeping your Arcade spotless grants up to +5% extra popularity! But beware: for each trash item on the ground, this bonus decreases by 2%, and can even become negative if neglected.

Don't let a mess ruin your reputation!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274692/4687d58fa70817dbb55127d3aa059badcc21d4e6.png"][/img]

Cleaners are not available in the Demo or tutorial.

[b]Other changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue with window mode. [/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial starting budget changed to $6,000. [/p][/*][/list]

Console

notes.title: Guards and Vandals!
notes.notes:
The new update introduces a new type of [b]NPC[/b] and a new [b]employee[/b], along with some fixes:

[h3]Vandals[/h3]
These ill-intentioned NPCs just want to cause trouble; they enter the Arcade only to break machines. The higher the Arcade's popularity, the greater the chance they'll appear. They break 3 machines and then leave.

[h3]Guards[/h3]
New employees who patrol the Arcade. When detecting a Vandal, they run towards them to scare them away, becoming essential for your Arcade's safety.
To hire a guard, you must first research them in the Research Tree.
Depending on the Arcade's popularity and the number of vandals appearing, you may need to hire more guards, but be careful with their quantity as they have high salaries!

Guards and vandals are not available in the Demo or tutorial.

[h3]Other fixes:[/h3]
[list]
Fixed an issue where machines remained on after being used.
Fixed an issue where mechanics wouldn't repair certain machines.
Adjusted employee hiring costs.
Fixed maximum players for the Arcade machine to 1.
Reduced rotation speeds for the claw machine and ATM.
[/list]
